title: Add VPC control plane: cross-account peering, interface endpoints, security groups, Route53 delegation
author: Ava Martinez
ci_status: pass (e2e flake on first run, rerun succeeded)
release_notes: Adds cross-account VPC peering support, interface endpoints for SSM/EC2/STS, security group templates for control plane instances, and optional Route53 delegation for private control plane DNS. Includes migration and rollback notes.
description: Motivation: Enable customers to provision a private control plane that spans accounts and VPCs while keeping DNS and endpoint access secure and automatable. This PR adds Terraform modules and installer hooks to provision cross-account VPC peering, interface endpoints, security groups, and optional Route53 delegation for private control plane DNS. Summary of changes: 1) New terraform/modules/vpc-peering module to create cross-account peering with automated route propagation and validations. 2) Updated terraform/modules/vpc-network to expose interface endpoint integration points and security group attachments. 3) New terraform/modules/interface-endpoints module that creates/accepts interface endpoints for SSM, EC2 messages, STS, and optional KMS endpoint in customer account. 4) Security groups: standardized control-plane-sg and control-plane-helpers-sg templates, with least-privilege ingress rules documented. 5) Route53: optional delegation module that creates hosted zone delegation records and adds required IAM role/policies for cross-account zone association. 6) Installer hooks and Helm chart values: installer/upgrade hooks to apply peering and endpoint changes safely during upgrades, plus new values in charts/control-plane/values.schema.yaml. Testing: unit Terraform validation, integration tests in perf-canary against a 2-account lab, e2e provisioning with the private-installer in CI (first run hit a flake on account IAM rate limits; rerun passed). Migration path: existing single-account installs are unaffected by default. To adopt cross-account peering, operators must supply remote account IDs and set enable_cross_account_peering=true. Rollback: the module supports destroy-on-failure and has idempotent create/delete flows; rollback steps documented in docs/private-deployments/vpc-control-plane-upgrade-rollback.md. Security considerations: interface endpoints use endpoint policies limited to required services; SG changes default to deny-all-except-managed rules. Backwards-compatibility: changes are additive; Helm values default to previous behavior. Related: ENG-4821, ENG-4890, SUP-1123. Checklist: - [x] Terraform modules implemented and unit-tested - [x] Installer hooks integrated and smoke-tested - [x] Helm values/schema updated - [x] Docs updated with migration/rollback steps - [x] Reviewed and approved by networking and security leads
